name: ce
sound: k before a, o, u; s before e, i (th in most of Spain)

name: ge
sound: hard g before a, o, u; throaty h before e, i

name: erre
sound: quick tap; rolled at the start of a word

name: te
sound: t, tongue on the teeth, no puff

name: equis
sound: ks; h in some place names

name: ye
sound: y; "ee" alone or at the end of a word
